gdp.label: Nominal GDP
gdp.desc: Total value of goods and services produced in the state in 2025, in current dollars.

gdpPerCapita.label: GDP per capita
gdpPerCapita.desc: Nominal GDP divided by resident population — a measure of economic output per person, not of personal income.

growth.label: Real GDP growth, 2025
growth.desc: Inflation-adjusted change in state output over calendar year 2025.

gdpShare.label: Share of US GDP
gdpShare.desc: The state's share of the sum of all state GDP.

pcpi.label: Per capita personal income
pcpi.desc: All personal income received by residents divided by population, including wages, investment income and transfer payments.

unemp.label: Unemployment rate
unemp.desc: Share of the labour force actively looking for work, seasonally adjusted.

lfpr.label: Labour force participation
lfpr.desc: Share of the civilian population aged 16+ that is working or looking for work.

mhi.label: Median household income
mhi.desc: The midpoint of the household income distribution — half of households earn more, half less.

mhiAdj.label: Median income, cost-of-living adjusted
mhiAdj.desc: Median household income divided by the state's price level. This is what the money actually buys.

poverty.label: Poverty rate
poverty.desc: Share of people with income below the federal poverty threshold for their household size.

col.label: Cost of living index
col.desc: Regional price level relative to the national average. 110 means goods and services cost about 10% more than the US average.

minWage.label: Minimum wage
minWage.desc: The binding state minimum wage in 2026. Where a state sets none or sets a lower figure, the federal $7.25 applies.

homeValue.label: Median home value
homeValue.desc: Typical value of an owner-occupied home.

ownRate.label: Homeownership rate
ownRate.desc: Share of occupied housing units that are owner-occupied.

priceToIncome.label: Home price to income ratio
priceToIncome.desc: Median home value divided by median household income — a rough housing affordability measure. Above about 5 is generally considered strained.

itaxTop.label: Top individual income tax rate
itaxTop.desc: Highest marginal state rate on individual income in 2026. Nine states levy none.

salesCombined.label: Combined sales tax rate
salesCombined.desc: State rate plus the population-weighted average local rate.

propTax.label: Effective property tax rate
propTax.desc: Property taxes paid as a share of owner-occupied home value. Each 1.00% is $1,000 a year per $100,000 of value.

corpTax.label: Top corporate income tax rate
corpTax.desc: Highest marginal state rate on corporate income. Some states levy gross-receipts taxes instead, shown here as 0%.

burden.label: State and local tax burden
burden.desc: All state and local taxes paid by a state's residents as a share of their income, including taxes paid to other states.

gasTax.label: State gas tax
gasTax.desc: State excise and related per-gallon taxes on motor fuel, excluding the 18.4¢ federal tax.

vcrime.label: Violent crime rate
vcrime.desc: Murder, rape, robbery and aggravated assault reported to police, per 100,000 residents.

pcrime.label: Property crime rate
pcrime.desc: Burglary, larceny-theft and motor vehicle theft reported to police, per 100,000 residents.

murder.label: Homicide rate
murder.desc: Murders and non-negligent manslaughters per 100,000 residents.

popChg.label: Population change since 2020
popChg.desc: Percent change in resident population from the April 2020 census to July 2025.

ba.label: Bachelor's degree or higher
ba.desc: Share of adults 25 and older holding at least a four-year degree.

uninsured.label: Uninsured rate
uninsured.desc: Share of the population without health insurance coverage.
